items.title: Iranian spies hit Windows machines with Chosen Brick data-stealing malware

items.lede: Government agencies are warning that Iranian state-linked hackers are using a Windows malware strain named CHOSEN BRICK to target dissidents, activists, and journalists worldwide. [...]
